note: 16 Nov, the owner: "we should do the mail and the real jobs on a parallel rental"; "be sure to have another evaluation of our amendments after the mail run finishes here, before we do more rentals". HELD: not rented until the loop checks (src/answer-checks.js and the Maximus planning fixes, et6g5x b18db168, merged here) have been evaluated again on the first mail run's results and the owner gives the go by card. The after run for the loop checks: one served brain, stock Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (tool shape 4), two kinds of work at once. (1) The same 30 inbox jobs (mail-jobs.mjs --catalog) at all four efforts, now with the mail catalog on (groups, bulk acts, needs_reply, lists, unsubscribe, reply drafts filled in by code), for a before/after on the mail jobs. (2) The first 200 of the 800 real jobs (jobs-fix/jobs.jsonl, read only from lab-kit-shape4) with the 800 run's flags and its saved scenes (jobs-fix1/scenes.jsonl), so the same 200 compare before/after. Each is a jobs-matrix variant with its own folder (after1-<name>). do-jobs runs the harness self-test (11 checks) before any job. Scored by code (mail-score.mjs, jobs-gate.mjs), then every run read by Opus 5.5. L40S or RTX 6000 Ada, 18 slots. Caps 3 h / $4. Later, the owner's question "how small of a brain?": the same catalog jobs on Qwen 4B and 9B (each its own server), not in this plan yet. (3) The Office jobs (office-jobs.mjs, from the Office thread's branch): variant office; the 8 that need LibreOffice drop out at pre-flight unless --office <soffice> is added to that variant. Needs office-jobs.mjs and office-score.mjs in the kit (run this plan from a branch that has both). 21 slots x 32K.
